details:
Since you guys decided to start adding some new updates to better the experience of VRChat, I have a few suggestions.
- The ability to zoom the camera in when pressing a button. This is good for both taking pictures and checking a user who is far away so that you can turn off their avatar from a distance, if you don't want everyones avatar on but want to be selective.
- The ability to search avatars using an actual search bar. You can just make it where private and removed avatars don't show up in the search.
- The ability to teleport to players. To nullify this being OP, you can make it where you can have a settings thing where you can allow only friends or anyone to teleport to you.
- An Inbox.
That way you can send messages to your friends when they aren't online, or when you wanna let them know something but don't wanna join them. This can also be used for communicating with people not your friends if you allow it, to allow you to contact map creators so that you can inform them if theres an issue or something with their world, so they can be aware and be able to fix it faster.
- An alert when your friend joins or leaves a room that you can turn on or off. This is good for people like me, who are constantly anxiously checking to make sure I know if anyone came in or left.
These are just a few things, but I will be sure to throw out more as I think of them.
title: A Few Suggestions
